Security at Acme

This page describes how Acme protects customer data.

Encryption

Customer data is encrypted in transit with TLS 1.3 and at rest with AES-256.

Access

Staff sign in with hardware keys; passwords alone never open a production system.

Report a problem to security@acme.com and we answer within 2 business days.
